name: Bird MCP Server
description: Lets agents send and track email, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice through Bird, set up domains, senders, and numbers, and manage templates over a hosted OAuth MCP or the bird CLI.

skills.name: Multichannel Messaging
skills.description: Sends single or batch email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages and reads their delivery status and event logs.

skills.name: Channel Setup
skills.description: Adds and verifies email sending domains, claims and registers SMS senders, and searches and buys phone numbers.

skills.name: Email Deliverability
skills.description: Authors and previews email templates, manages suppressions, and configures dedicated IPs and pools.

skills.name: Recipient Verification
skills.description: Sends and checks one-time passcodes, falls back across channels, and looks up phone numbers or email addresses.

skills.name: MCP Events
skills.description: Subscribes the client to Bird events, such as new mail in a mailbox, and delivers each one as a signed webhook.
